body: Australian law firm Clayton Utz has appointed Johan Pietersz as a partner, in a move focused on widening its PE deal capability nationwide. Pietersz will work from the firm’s Sydney office, where his focus on corporate mergers and acquisitions is expected to bolster the national team that handles private equity transactions.
